id: \bHello there.\nWould you like to hear about my Spritzee?
en: \bHello there.\nWould you like to hear about my Spritzee?

id: \bThank you for listening to that. You can have this; it's no trouble. I am a bit too old to be using it.
en: \bThank you for listening to that. You can have this; it's no trouble. I am a bit too old to be using it.
it: \bGrazie per avermi ascoltato. Tieni, prendi questo; non è un problema. Sono un po' troppo vecchio per usarlo.

id: \bDid you come to hear about my Pokémon again?
en: \bDid you come to hear about my Pokémon again?
it: \bSei venuto di nuovo a sentir parlare del mio Pokémon?

id: \rYou're a Trainer aren't you?\nCome see me when you beat the Gym Leader of this town.
en: \rYou're a Trainer aren't you?\nCome see me when you beat the Gym Leader of this town.
it: \rSei un Allenatore, vero?\nVieni a trovarmi quando avrai battuto il Capopalestra di questa città.

id: \rGood job on defeating her! Take this for your efforts.
en: \rGood job on defeating her! Take this for your efforts.
it: \rBel lavoro, l'hai sconfitta! Prendi questo per il tuo impegno.

id: \bMy Heracross is so beautiful. I bet no one else around has one better.
en: \bMy Heracross is so beautiful. I bet no one else around has one better.
it: \bIl mio Heracross è bellissimo. Scommetto che nessuno qui intorno ne ha uno migliore.
